system.description:
A sea and coastal ranger — tracking prey along coastlines, through mangrove, across tidal flats.

  • Sea Legs: Advantage on Scale checks involving coastal cliffs, ship rigging, or any wet surface. Combat Marauder's damage bonus also applies to creatures with a swim speed.
  • Tidewalker: Advantage on Track and Survival checks in coastal or island environments, and on checks identifying Jinia marine wildlife.
